description: This Java source file defines a class 'Tabs5' which extends TabActivity and implements TabHost.TabContentFactory to demonstrate tab scrolling when too many tabs are displayed in an Android application. It dynamically creates 30 tabs with simple text content.

classes.name: Tabs5
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating tab scrolling with multiple tabs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and adds 30 tabs with labels 'Tab 1' to 'Tab 30'.

methods.name: createTabContent
methods.description: Creates and returns a TextView displaying content for a tab given its tag.
